questions: Check companion resolution, no-plan receipts, escalation and reuse of the shared resource map.
Preserve fast DIRECT checks and measure observer activation costs for long validations.
decision: Keep validate-or-fix as a thin plan-free entrypoint into the shared monitoring and evidence engine, with explicit repair authorization and no hidden second orchestration state.
code_observations: validatectl has a guarded standalone validation path, receipts, classification and repair-route selection. The companion skill resolves the shared implementation rather than duplicating all runner logic.
DIRECT can opt into monitored validation without creating a plan, but must still preserve the user's fast path for short deterministic checks.
implementation_steps: Use a small trigger contract: plain build/lint/unit checks run directly; long, stateful or repeatedly ambiguous checks can request mapped monitoring without a TODO plan.
Pin standalone receipts to command, map and relevant source state, and give every runtime artifact an owned location outside product files.
Keep monitoring deterministic until an eligible ambiguity event; elapsed time alone does not force a paid observer.
Separate repair proposal, authorized edit execution and independent deterministic validation. The observer cannot approve its own repair.
Test companion discovery, missing/mismatched shared version and installation/uninstall boundaries. Fail clearly rather than importing a random similarly named module.
Keep validate-only and repair authorization distinct; DIRECT monitoring creates no implementation TODO plan.
Reuse the same runtime state, map, classification and cancellation code instead of copying logic into the companion.
Pin standalone validation sessions to command/input/map generation and preserve unrelated plans and user logs.
proposed_acceptance_tests: A short passing command leaves no manifest, TODO or orchestration directory.
A long mapped validation records progress and can diagnose a stall without creating a plan.
A successful old receipt is rejected after source or command changes.
A missing companion/shared implementation produces an actionable version error.
A failed repair never overwrites a successful receipt or claims completion from a model narrative.
Validate-only failure leaves source files unchanged.
Standalone monitored validation creates no plan manifest or TODO checklist.
A missing companion runtime dependency fails before test/model execution.
Authorized repair obeys write scope and passes independent rerun before success.

cost_model: Compare setup tokens and diagnostic latency with unmonitored direct testing and full orchestration, including retry/repair cost. Shared code reduces maintenance, not necessarily model runtime by itself.

No end-user installation or live repair model was exercised. Package dependency resolution and cross-platform execution remain future implementation tests.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated provider invocation, live quota/cost benchmark, independent model review, or Windows runtime test was performed in this research revision.
previous_decision: Keep validate-or-fix as a lightweight companion using shared monitoring primitives, with no plan creation and explicit repair acceptance.
revision_delta: The revision focuses on composition and consent boundaries: DIRECT may use monitored validation without creating a plan, but validation and code modification are separate requested effects.
decision_analysis: The companion skill should not duplicate map, process, failure or quota logic. Use one shared runtime library/control entrypoint and a short intent router. A small direct task can request monitored tests without paying for a TODO graph, plan review or manifest; only the explicitly selected validation session metadata is created.

Validate-only must not silently repair. Repair mode can be explicitly authorized by the user request or selected policy, then use a bounded attempt budget, allowed write scope and independent rerun of checks. A failing test caused by service health or permissions is not a reason to raise the model tier.

Preserve standalone session resumability without borrowing an unrelated active plan or rewriting its task statuses. Pin command, input and resource-map generation so a completed validation from one session cannot satisfy another. Cleanup should remove only owned validation artifacts under retention policy; it must not erase product changes.

Documentation and packaging need to make the dependency between the two skills explicit. Prefer a shared installed runtime path resolved by deterministic discovery rather than copying code into both bundles. If a companion dependency is absent, report an actionable preflight error, not a partially working fallback with weaker checks.
